steps.en: Install and start the daemon on the server that will run your crawls
steps.zh: 在跑爬虫的服务器上安装并启动守护进程

steps.en: From your project, package it as an egg and upload it to the daemon
steps.zh: 在项目里把它打成 egg 并上传给守护进程

steps.en: Stores the upload via addversion.json as a named project version; the latest version runs by default
steps.zh: 经 addversion.json 存为具名项目版本，默认跑最新版

steps.en: Queue a crawl with one HTTP call instead of SSHing in
steps.zh: 一条 HTTP 调用排一个抓取，不必 SSH 进机器

steps.en: Spawns a managed scrapy crawl subprocess within max_proc capacity, writing logs and item feeds to disk
steps.zh: 在 max_proc 上限内拉起 scrapy crawl 子进程，日志落盘

steps.en: Watch what's running, or stop a job, over the same API
steps.zh: 用同一套 API 查看在跑什么、停掉某个作业

value.en: Local Scrapy spiders become a remotely deployable, schedulable, monitorable crawl service on one box
value.zh: 本地 Scrapy 爬虫变成单机上可远程部署、调度、监控的抓取服务
